stepTitle: Which model has the highest precision?
stepBody:
Suppose we fit three classifiers which produce the following confusion matrices, where each count is given as true label and predicted label:
• Model A: true $$0$$ predicted 0: $$40$$, true $$1$$ predicted 0: $$10$$, true $$0$$ predicted 1: $$10$$, true $$1$$ predicted 1: $$40$$
• Model B: true $$0$$ predicted 0: $$10$$, true $$1$$ predicted 0: $$0$$, true $$0$$ predicted 1: $$10$$, true $$1$$ predicted 1: $$80$$
• Model C: true $$0$$ predicted 0: $$5$$, true $$1$$ predicted 0: $$10$$, true $$0$$ predicted 1: $$5$$, true $$1$$ predicted 1: $$80$$##figure1.gif##
